Here is a check you can answer by typing the letter in the chat.

```quiz
{"title":"Network basics","questions":[{"question":"Which OSI layer makes forwarding decisions based on IP addresses?","options":["Data link","Network","Transport","Session"],"answer":"B","explanation":"Routers forward packets at the network layer, using the destination IP address."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."},{"question":"Which protocol hands out IPv4 addresses to clients automatically?","options":["DNS","NTP","DHCP","SNMP"],"answer":"C","explanation":"DHCP leases addresses, masks, gateways and DNS servers to clients."},{"question":"Which tool shows each hop on the path to a destination?","options":["ping","traceroute","netstat","arp"],"answer":"B","explanation":"traceroute raises the TTL hop by hop and reports each router that answers."}]}
```
